public class fivedimpoints{
    static int n;
    static int[][] coord;
    static long[][][] vect;
    static boolean[] bad;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException{
        FastScanner in = new FastScanner(System.in); 
        n = in.nextInt();
        if(n > 11){
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        coord = new int[n][5];

            }

                }
            }

        long prod;

                if(j != i){
                    for(int k = 0; k < n; k++){
                        if(k != j && k != i){
                            prod = 0;

                                prod += vect[j][i][m]*vect[k][i][m];

            throw new InputMismatchException();

            curChar = 0;

                numChars = stream.read(buf);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new InputMismatchException();

            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;

        return buf[curChar++];
    }

        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
